text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The URA Finale is gradually gaining momentum as more and more people start looking forward to the event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, <chrname>'s popularity still leaves a lot to be desired. We're going to have to try a lot harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Likewise, <chrname> is also steadily growing her fan base and getting closer to becoming a star Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Likewise, <chrname> 's overflowing appeal is winning hearts left and right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After their breakthrough several days prior, Trainer Kiryuin and Happy Meek are also giving their all to prepare for the race.
